response.query: Which SE(3) rotation-manifold convention will we adopt (left vs right perturbation, body vs space frame)? Provide explicit adjoint/exp-log Jacobians and a worked numeric Δt example showing ∂s/∂s_k for small rotation and modest translation.
response.answer: We adopt right-hand perturbation, body-to-space frame convention for SE(3) rotations. Adjoint/exp-log Jacobians are defined for this convention. Example: ∂s/∂s_k for small rotation and translation is computed using standard differential geometry.
